caption: The drawing features a combination of objects centered on the page, predominantly featuring a bird, mechanical elements, and two purple, gem-like shapes. At the top of the composition, there is an olive-green and yellow bird with brown details, perched sideways. Directly behind the bird's head and upper back, there is a small, round, purple gemstone. The bird is perched atop a horizontal metallic bar. Below and slightly in front of the bird is a larger oval purple gemstone, which is positioned above a vertical metal bar that is ornately patterned with floral or leafy designs. At the bottom end of this bar is a key-like object, also detailed with patterns and a clover-shaped opening. The objects are placed within a rectangular border centered on a beige background. At the bottom edge of the border, the words "EXACT SIZE" are written, and at the lower right corner outside the border, the name "R. MANUPELLI" is printed.
title: Pincushion and Thread Holder
